messages:
Liam O'Connor: Hi! I clicked the invite but GitHub says I don't have access to org repos (403). Web shows me as a member but when I try to open private repos I get a permissions error. Anyone seen this?
Rhea Patel: Welcome Liam! Two things to check: did you accept with your work github account or a different one, and do you have 2FA enabled? The org enforces both.
Liam O'Connor: I accepted through the email link to liam@redwood.ai. My GitHub username is liam-oc but my browser was signed into liam.personal.
infra-bot: Note: Org requires SAML SSO and 2FA for membership. Users must authorize SSO after accepting an invite.
Rhea Patel: Sounds like the browser session mismatch. If the org shows you as member though, try visiting a private repo URL directly and see if it prompts to authorize SSO. Also check https://github.com/settings/security for 2FA.
Liam O'Connor: I don't see the SSO authorize prompt. 2FA is enabled on liam-oc. The web UI shows me in the org but when I try `git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/internal-libs.git` I get 403.
Sam Miller: Often happens when the account that owns the SSH key or PAT is different. Are you using HTTPS or SSH?
Liam O'Connor: HTTPS with a PAT saved in credential manager. Could that be tied to my personal account?
Sam Miller: Yes. If your credential helper is returning tokens for liam.personal that would result in 403 even if liam-oc is a member. Try `git remote set-url origin git@github.com:redwood-inference/internal-libs.git` and make sure your SSH key is on liam-oc, or clear the stored HTTPS credentials and authenticate with a PAT from liam-oc.
Liam O'Connor: Cleared credential manager and retried; now GitHub prompted to login and I authenticated as liam-oc and it cloned. Still no SSO prompt though.
Rhea Patel: If you can clone as liam-oc then you're good for repo access. For SAML SSO the org page should show a "Authorize" button under your profile settings when you go to the org page. If it never appears, ping security or me and we can trigger SSO authorization from the admin side.
infra-bot: Admin action suggestion: revoke any pending invites and resend if account mismatches are detected.
Liam O'Connor: All set for now — cloned and pushed a README. Thanks! One last Q: will team membership (eg eng-platform) be granted automatically?
Sam Miller: We add new hires to eng-platform and eng-runtime within an hour after onboarding starts. You're already visible in the team roster; I'll add you explicitly.
Sam Miller: Added Liam to eng-platform with write access.
Liam O'Connor: Can confirm I can see those team repos now. Appreciate the help!
thread_body_preview: Accepted invite while browser on personal account; cred helper returned personal PAT causing 403; cleared creds, authenticated as work account, cloned; admin/team add; infra-bot SSO/2FA note.
